text: Given a mocked form definition with a client_org dropdown question whose choices each carry tenantId/haloClientId/rewstOrgId, When mspbots_forms_form_get(form_id, field_id="client_org") is called, Then the returned JSON's choices array has every choice with all three properties present and no truncated flag set.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_returns_full_choice_metadata -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test asserts response choices all carry tenantId/haloClientId/rewstOrgId, no truncated key, and that include=definition was forced upstream even though the caller passed no include.

text: Given a mocked question whose choices list alone would serialize past the 20,000-char budget, When the same filtered call is made, Then the response is valid JSON with truncated: true, an original_count, and every choice present in the truncated list has all of its own properties intact.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_truncates_oversized_choices_gracefully -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test uses 300 synthetic choices (comfortably over the 20,000-char cap) and asserts truncated=true, original_count=300, 0 < len(choices) < 300, every surviving choice still has all 3 properties, and the serialized payload is <= 20,000 chars.

text: Given a field_id that matches no question in the mocked definition, When the filtered call is made, Then the response is an error envelope with code not_found naming the requested field_id and form_id.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_not_found_returns_structured_error -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test asserts error.code == "not_found", error.retryable == false, and the message names both the requested field_id and form_id.

text: Given the exact same mocked backend response used by this repo's existing mspbots_forms_form_get tests, When the tool is called with no field_id, Then the output is unchanged from before this change.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_without_field_id_is_unchanged -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test asserts the decoded payload equals the mocked backend response byte-for-byte and that the include param reaching the backend is exactly what the caller passed ("versions"), confirming field_id never forces include=definition when omitted.

text: [r2-amended] Given the real offboarding form f7528a78 v4 in the MSPbots demo tenant, When an operator with PROD/INT MCP access calls the shipped mspbots_forms_form_get(form_id="f7528a78", field_id="client_org"), Then the response contains all 185 real client_org options, and each option retains whichever of tenantId, haloClientId, and rewstOrgId are present for it in the source data (no requirement that every option carry a non-empty tenantId); the response is not collapsed to a truncation notice.
steps: Obtain PROD or INT MCP access with a valid API key + tenant for the MSPbots demo tenant
Call mspbots_forms_form_get(form_id="f7528a78", field_id="client_org") against the shipped build
Inspect the response's option list and count
expect: All 185 client_org options are present in the response (not 0, not a truncation-notice collapse); each option carries whichever of tenantId/haloClientId/rewstOrgId exist for it in the source definition; options genuinely lacking an attribute in source data are not required to carry it; graceful truncation per AC2 applies only if the real payload still exceeds the size budget after the fix
evidence: Not executed: this sandbox has no network path to a live PROD/INT MCP deployment or real tenant credentials. First run (round 1) found 0 of 185 options returned -- see TC7 for the regression test that reproduces the root cause locally without live access; AC5/TC5 itself still requires a live PROD/INT run once the dev leg's fix for TC7 ships.
rework_note: AC5 wording amended in PRD-21379-r2.md: round-1 wording required every option to have a non-empty tenantId, which 37 of 185 real options cannot satisfy (confirmed by Tom Lan's live test, comment 90170266253375).

text: [r2-new, regression -- source: dev feedback comment 90170266253375] Given a mocked client_org question shaped like the real form f7528a78 (choicesSource: {items: [...185 entries, 37 of them missing tenantId...], passAttributes: ["rewstOrgId","haloClientId","tenantId"]}, not a top-level choices list), When mspbots_forms_form_get(form_id, field_id="client_org") is called, Then the response is valid JSON containing all (or, if still oversized, gracefully truncated per AC2) options with their present attributes, and the response is never the generic "Result too large ... not list-shaped" notice.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_handles_choices_source_shape tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_choices_source_small_form_is_not_truncated -v -> 2 passed in 1.1s (commit 7f2f83e). Oversized case (185 items, 37 missing tenantId, matching the real form): response is valid JSON, never the "not list-shaped" notice, truncated=true, truncated_field="choices", original_count=185, 0 < len(choices) < 185, every surviving item keeps whichever of tenantId/haloClientId/rewstOrgId it has, payload <= 20,000 chars. Small-form complement (3 items, 1 missing tenantId): all 3 items present, truncated is absent, choicesSourcePassAttributes == ["rewstOrgId","haloClientId","tenantId"]. Fix: normalize_choice_source() in _survey_walk.py promotes choicesSource.items to a top-level "choices" key before dump_json_capped, so the existing AC2 truncation path (not a new one) handles it.
source: dev feedback: comment 90170266253375 (Tom Lan, [TEST · PRD-21379] FAIL, 2026-10-25) -- root cause: the real client_org question stores options under choicesSource (a dict with a nested items list) rather than a top-level choices list, so dump_json_capped's top-level-list scan (_json.py:28-30) finds no list field and collapses the entire payload to a 116-char truncation notice, discarding all 185 options. See PRD-21379-r2.md Rework triage for the full trace.

text: Given the new field_id code path, a code-level test confirms find_question_by_name is a pure function with no shared mutable state, and that the field_id branch uses the same per-request client_factory()/FormsAPIClient as every other branch.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_path_introduces_no_shared_state -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test (a) inspects _survey_walk module globals to confirm no mutable module-level state, (b) calls find_question_by_name twice with different definitions and confirms no cross-call leakage, and (c) drives two different tenants through the same field_id branch via the real per-request client_factory/contextvar path and confirms tenant-A's form data never leaks into tenant-B's response.
